[ff6464]Quest not found
Hm? See, I told you. No one is here...
This is strange. I know the presents are ready,\nbut they still need to be delivered...
Oh, my lady!
That voice, is that you Dunder the reindeer?!
Are you okay, my lady?!
Yeah, how about you? Are you okay?!
Finally you're here...I've been expecting you.
What, who's it? Show yourself!
Don't tell me...it's the anti Xmas energy?!\nBut how did it make it all the way here?!
You're so naive...Xmas energy and anti Xmas energy\nare really opposites and they clash, so they\nalways exist at the same time...!
Hey, what's so great about that book of yours?\nYou said without it we can't enter the forest,\nbut you see, the enemy just proved you wrong!!
I dunno!\nTo begin with, I've never heard that anti Xmas\nenergy shows up here!
Come to me if you wanna know why I'm here.\nThis guy will be staying with me till then...!
Aaaah! My ladyyy!
D-don't tell me...he's absorbing the Xmas energy\nfrom the presents we prepared?!
Is that a bad thing?
If we let the Xmas energy get absorbed like that,\nthe anti Xmas energy will become stronger!
And those presents will become spoiled and we\nwon't be able to give them out...!
No way!!\nWhat are you guys doing? Stay away from the\ntreasure!!
[ff6464]Quest not found
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Santabby!!
I-I see! The presents I prepared were his target!\nI haven't touched those presents, no wonder it\nfeels strange...
Phew, I unconsciously reacted to the treasure...\nLooks like we got tangled up in a troublesome\nsituation again.
But if I think about it again, that treasure is\nnot mine, so...
Aren't you gonna help?
What about the presents?
What? I'm a merchant, why would I even burden\nmyself with something troublesome and doesn't look\nprofitable...?
B-but, Dunder is in danger!\nMoreover, I can't distribute the presents without\nhim...
Hmmm...In that case, I'll help, but give me some\nof the presents later, agree?
What?! Oh yeah, the treasure!
Hey you!\nYou said you wanna give out presents, right?\nWhat are you gonna do now?
T-there's nothing I can do without Dunder...
Uggh, I'm so close to the treasure,\nI can't back out now...
Hey! Since you asked about the presents, you\nshould help!
So don't worry!\nWe'll definitely save the presents, oops...I mean\nDunder!
O-okay...\nPlease hurry and rescue Dunder before the other\npresents become spoiled too.

Dunder!
Ah! That smoke again...!
M-my lady...
Give Dunder back!\nHow did you get in here in the first place?!
I've always been here...\nThe place where both Xmas energy and anti Xmas\nenergy are...
S-so why now...!
Because this place just moved recently...
Huh? That's true. Dad also said it's been a while\nsince he moved this place...
Could it be that you couldn't move either because\nthe Xmas energy here has been weak...?
Bingo...\nMy name is Shawle.\nI'm your counterpart, Velly...
If you think you can stop me from restoring\nanti Xmas energy and get Dunder back,\nshow me...bwahahaha...!
Ow?!\nSorry, but could you please hold somewhere else?\nIt's kinda uncomfortable...
What? Hmm, is it ok here?
Ohhh oh?!\nNo, no, no, go up a little bit...!
S-stop moving! It's already heavy!
That Dunder guy seems to be just fine...
I-it seems so, but...\nHe's being kidnapped for sure.\nPlease hurry and save him...
Please!
[ff6464]Quest not found
F-finally, we're up here.
All right, Dunder, we're coming to save ya!
You're not as bad as I thought.\nBut it should be like this...otherwise my\nexistence would be in vain...
My, my lady...!
Uggh! Just give Dunder back already!
I haven't been here for a while either...\nSo lemme play with you a little longer...Hm?
Excuse me, I think something is...
Pom, pomm.
Hm?!\nW-what the?! Why are you here?!\nL-let go of me! Let go!
Put your claws away!\nDon't lick me!\nYou can't bite me either!!
Pomm?
?? What's that?\nLooks like Potum...but somehow different?
I know this guy.\nDon't do anything dangerous!
Pom~...
By the way, why is it here?\nCan it come here without the book too?
Hmm, maybe...it's because it's not a human.\nAlso it's not like the rule applies to all\nliving things...
Don't tell me you come here to play with the other\nmonsters?
A-at any rate, let's go to save Dunder!\nA-and you, please go to my house because it's\ndangerous here.
[ff6464]Quest not found
P-phew...\nFinally we're here.
My, my lady...!\nI'm sorry that you have to climb all the way up\nhere!
Wait, that's not what you should be sorry for\nthough. Anyway, what's this room?\nThere were extremely a lot of monsters.
Things are stored here before we sort them.\nPresents that are ready are also kept here first.
That means...this is the place with the most\ntreasure?!
Y-you could say that.\nBut what's more important now is to save Dunder.
Oh, you guys made it this far...\nInteresting...But it has to be like this.
My, my lady...!
Till when you wanna make us run here and there?!\nIt's enough! Just set Dunder free already!
C'mon, that's nothing, and you're already\ncomplaining? I still wanna have fun, you know...
Geez, c-coward!
Hihihi...our game can't just stop here...\nEugh! *Cough cough!
A-are you okay?
T-this is weird...*Cough cough!\nMaybe I mistook the amount of the smoke...*cough
Anyway, please do your best till we reach the\ndestination because I can literally do nothing\nnow.
Y-yeah...we'll somehow get there...\n*Cough cough!
Ugggh!\nI wonder what that guy really wants...!
W-who knows...\nBut now it's fine here!\nLet's go save Dunder!
[ff6464]Quest not found
Dunder! I know you're hiding him, right?
Stop it, we're exhausted.\nShawle or whoever you are, stop hiding and show\nyourself at least once!
That's true...To reward you for your strenuous\nefforts so far, I'll specially let you see me.\nYou should feel honored...!
Wait, what?!\nAre you seriously coming out?!
You finally showed up!
Since you showed us your true identity, that means\nyou have contemplated your mistake, right?\nRight?! Say yes!!
Oh, shut up! That's not right!!\nH-humph! I just got bored of playing\nhide-and-seek...
I'll be waiting in the back room.\nIf you want Dunder back, come get him yourself...
Only if you can, tho...
Noooo!!\nGeez, he just disappeared!
What's this room?
This is where we manage and decide what presents\nto make.
Since the presents here are all trial products,\nI think they are okay...
Hmm, but does this door open?\nThat guy told us to come though.
All the doors in this building can be opened by\nmy father and me...
I-it can't be opened! Why...\nOhhh?? I-it's sealed!
It's sealed? What do you mean?
Oh shoot! So this is what he meant when he said\n"only if you can" earlier...What do we do then...?
We also need more Xmas energy!
But, how do we get that Xmas energy here?
Um, umm...
Oh, right!! With this!
What??\nWhat's with that weird candle?\nIt kinda looks cheap too.
T-this is Sacred Candle!\nAll the presents made here come with special\ncandle like this.
This item and the presents contain Xmas energy.\nSo if we collect this, we'll regain the Xmas\nenergy and I'll be able to open the door!
Therefore, I want you to collect [ffff64]10 Sacred Red\nCandles and 10 Sacred Blue Candles[ffffff] ASAP!
Huh, all right.\nCuz it seems like I can't get the treasure\notherwise...
I'm counting on you!
[ff6464]Quest not found
I think we need more.\nI'm counting on you to save Dunder!
[ff6464]Quest not found
Thanks!\nI think it's enough to open the door!
Well, I'll break the anti Xmas energy seal,\nso stay away.
Ugggggh, ummmmph\nHeave-ho...!
You're using brute force!
? W-what?
Oh, not push, but pull.

Hmm, since the dolls also look busy, it seems that\nthe preparation for Xmas is going smoothly this\nyear~!
Dunder! The toy-making machine is not working!
Oh, speak of the devil, there they are!
I-I'm sorry!\nThe machine has run out of the "Magic Black Coal"\nthat powers it!
What have you been doing?!\nI've told you so many times to check the remaining\nstock!
Um, Velly~?
What about the presents for the children? Have you\nasked them what they want?!
I-I'm sorry, my lady...I've been really busy for\nthe past few days, so I haven't...
Tch, seriously, what have you been doing?!\nWe need to prepare presents that everyone will\nlike.
Hey, Velly!\nDon't ignore me!\nYou’re making me feel so left out~!
Oh! It's you and Pelulu!
Miss Pelulu and the adventurer!\nMerry Xmas!
I know you guys always do this, but you seem\nbusier than usual this year~.
I took my time because I thought we still had\ntime, but then this unexpected thing happened...\nI have no idea how I got into this mess either...
That sounds like the kind of excuse a kid would\nmake for not doing their homework.
Lady Velly, we don't have time to be talking about\nthe past right now...
You're right! We need to find out what the\nchildren want quickly!
Sigh, why do I have to do something like this...
Hey, Velly! I've gathered some wood that could add\nan accent to the presents.
Shawle! You came back at the right time! I want\nyou to secretly go and find out what the children\nwant for Xmas!
What?!
You must be kidding me!! Why do I have to do more\nXmas-related stuff?!
Come on, please help us! We've got a ton of other\nthings to prepare!
No thanks!
Please, do us a favor!
Nope!
Please, please, please!
Shawle's anti-Christmas aura seems to get weaker\nevery year~.
Ugh, alright, alright!\nBut no more after this!
Thanks! You're a lifesaver!
Dunder! Let's begin to decorate this place!
Okay, Lady Velly!
We've got everything we need for the presents!
Yes! The wrapping paper and ribbons are ready too!
It's time to start making the presents! But the\nmachine has run out of fuel...?!
W-what~?
You guys came to enjoy Xmas, right~? But at this\nrate, we might not even be able to celebrate Xmas!\nRight, Dunder?
You're right, my lady!
It seems that they wanna make us help them~.
But lemme tell you first, we're not as kind as\nShawle.
If you want us to help you, you’ve got to reward\nus, you know~?
O-okay! I promise I'll reward you as much as\npossible!
So? What do you want us to do~?
We need to operate various machines to make\nthe presents, but we don't have enough\n"Magic Black Coal" to power them!
I want you to collect this "Magic Black Coal" as\nmuch as possible!
I guess we have no choice~!\nAlright, we'll try~!
Thanks! You can find a lot of "Magic Black Coal"\nin the Aldozat Forest, located beyond the Reindeer\nForest!
Some weak monsters might have it, so try beating\nthem!
Got it~!
But then again, Aldozat is a bright and quiet\nforest, so spotting a monster like that could be\ntricky! Well, I'm counting on you!
Ahaha! So Shawle is an adult now? How did you come\nup with such a funny joke?!
No, it's not a joke. That's what the great spirit\nsaid too...
Alright then let's not waste time and tell us what\nthe great spirit said to you now~!
Hm...Do you guys remember Gegner?
Oh, the tone-deaf devil who spread anti-Xmas\nenergy waves last year!
Yes. Those anti-Xmas energy waves have spread all\nthe way to the remote areas of Navida.
Some of those energy waves don't go away\nnaturally. They remain in various places and\nappear to have awakened the anti-Xmas energy.
They've awakened the anti-Xmas energy? What do you\nmean~?
The Dark Abies...A giant tree filled with\nanti-Xmas energy.
Oh! I think that guy mentioned that name! He said\nsomething about feeding the tree~.
I see...The Dark Abies has been secretly growing\nby absorbing anti-Xmas energy waves. I heard it's\neven started developing the ability to think.
You mean it can talk although it's a tree?
The great spirit believes it's likely true.\nThe fateful encounter Shawle mentioned might refer\nto his encounter with the Dark Abies.
The Dark Abies has been releasing anti-Xmas energy\nacross a vast area from its roots.
Because of that, the monsters become agitated and\nthey're now invading Navida.
The Xmas knights have also been mobilized, but\nthere are too many monsters to handle.
And Shawle, who was originally on the anti-Xmas\nside, seems to have been greatly affected and\nturned into what he is now...
What will happen to Shawle then?
The great spirit believes that the Dark Abies is\nacting on instinct and sees Shawle only as a tool.
What exactly does that mean~?
He'll probably only be used to grow anti-Xmas\nenergy until he dies.
Oh no, Shawle is in danger!
Yeah, I know...But the monsters' attacks are only\ngetting more intense.
I'm sure the Dark Abies plays a part here and they\nwill probably never stop.
We, the Xmas Knights, already have our hands full\njust trying to handle this matter.
Hey, I want you to save Shawle! I'll do my best to\nhelp too!
Oh, Lady Velly, you're impressive as always!\nI'll be by your side and support you with\neverything I've got!
I'm sorry, but please...Help us...
Well, although Shawle is all talk, cocky, and\nuseless, I guess we can't just abandon him~!
Thanks...You should be able to find the Dark Abies\nin the depths of the Aldozat Forest.\nWe're counting on you!
Alright, Dunder! Let's go!
Okay, my lady!
